title: Children with Easter Baskets in Yard, 1939 Fullerton CA B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: FADE PROOF APR 21 1939 Finished by B. D. WOOD Fullerton, California
description: An intimate backyard snapshot from April 1939 capturing two young children holding woven baskets filled with Easter eggs along a stone pathway. A young boy in front wears a dark zip-up jacket and trousers, looking solemnly off-camera, while a small toddler in floral patterned bottoms and a sweater carries a small basket. In the background, a father figure bends down attentively beside the home, and the edge of a woman's braided hairstyle is visible in the upper right corner. Processed by B. D. Wood in Fullerton, California, this image reflects classic mid-20th-century American family traditions during the closing years of the Great Depression.
